dialogues.dialogue: It would be nice if the power came back if I just pulled it down.
... No luck. Of course it's stuck.
It's fine, at least I'm one step closer. It looks like the emergency light system requires some sort of code that I can input here.
It's a bunch of digits... I don't think I saw any sort of number code lying around the room. Not that I would even be able to see it in the dark.
Perhaps this label... is a hint in itself?
I'll just have to work with what I have. I'll keep thinking about it.
